safety_health_committee_001.evidence: Within twenty (20) duty days following the opening of school, a Standing Safety Committee shall be organized at each site, and a joint Safety Committee shall be organized at the District.

safety_environment_006.evidence: Once a unit member reports an unsafe, unhealthy, and/or unsanitary condition to her/his immediate supervisor, the District shall begin investigation within five (5) days. If the District finds an unsafe, unhealthy, and/or unsanitary condition, the District shall begin to take steps to correct the conditions within ten (10) duty days.
